Ruling: batch #319 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「22915 同意」 2026-10-12T01:53Z

Director seat, summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB` (GitHub `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay). Batch #319 (two cards, this one first) was presented in chat with this seat's own readings and the recommendation "A, fallback B"; the maintainer answered 「22915 同意」, which takes the recommendation. Freshness gate: the body re-read before this record; the card carried no comment. Thread-read: none.

Premises re-run on `origin/main` (`7dbb89dc`) in this act: the ADR-0087 addendum's closed vocabulary lists exactly six categories, `no-migration-prescription` "is refused by a body that carries a migration prescription", and `runtime-interface-only` "inherits the `no-migration-prescription` refusal"; D7 (`:747`) names the compiler as the channel and records that the earlier exemption "was held by a detector miss rather than by a positive finding"; PR #22875 merged as `7de0265fc7` with `15205-email-templates-resolve-registry.md` carrying a FROM → TO block under `no-migration-prescription`; 81 pending changesets declare BREAKING and hold `no-migration-prescription` (the card counted 80 before #22875 landed).

## The ruling

**A: ADR-0087 gains a seventh disposition category for a changeset that retires published runtime exports and carries a FROM → TO block, resting on re-runnable predicates.**
- Spelling: `<!-- adr-0087: not-required (runtime-export-retired <package>#<name>[, ...]) <why> -->`.
- Predicates the gate re-verifies on every run: each named export is reachable from the package's published entry at the merge base and absent at HEAD; none is a metadata surface (not `*.zod.ts`, not `packages/spec/src/contracts/**`, not an object definition) and no metadata surface references it at the base; a FROM → TO block is admitted only when its FROM operands are exactly the named exports. The category inherits nothing it cannot prove: a body whose FROM operands name anything else keeps the `no-migration-prescription` refusal.
- The addendum records the category beside `runtime-interface-only` and `type-surface-only`, with the worked example (`15205-email-templates-resolve-registry.md`) and its measured history, as the two neighbours have.
- Existing changesets are not re-graded; new retirements use the category.
- ⛔ Not taken: **B** (register a D3 metadata-migration entry per such changeset: host-code renames in the ledger `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide carry, against D7 / D8's reasoning that the compiler, not the ledger, is the channel for a TypeScript consumer); **C** (a prose reading that a FROM → TO block naming only package exports is not a prescription, with the detector relaxed to match: the gate would admit by the author's word, the shape D7 was written to retire).

## Why on the first axis

ADR-0087's vocabulary is closed and every exemption rests on a positive, re-runnable finding; D7 and #13080 added the two neighbouring classes exactly this way. A compiler-carried retirement of published exports is a third such class, and it recurs with ADR-0131's v18 retirements. 自检:只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否(② 面窄:确定 1 份、疑似 2 份;③ A 逐个核对点名的导出,写错即拒;④ 偏 B,成本差确定,但 B 的代价是迁移账本混入宿主代码条目)。A is more than 3× the cost of B; the first-axis readings are not close (B contradicts D7 / D8), so the letter stands.

Workload (#22597's rule): `domain:devx` · 1 PR touching `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (governed, Tier H: the maintainer's APPROVED review, then the owning seat lands it) plus `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` predicates and self-tests · precedent #13080's sixth category, PR #13596 (+956 / −10). Confidence gap: the class is measured narrow (one certain member among 81); the predicate "reachable from the package's published entry at the merge base" needs the dev to pick the resolver the api-surface gates already use rather than a new one.

Prior rulings read: ADR-0087 D7 (#8299, PR #8456) and D8; #13080's ruling 5468992520 (`type-surface-only`, PR #13596); #17357; `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 22915` in this act: 203 hits, ADR-0087 D3 / D7, ADR-0131 D13 / D5, ADR-0059 §3, ADR-0076 D12, ADR-0081 §2, ADR-0120 D7, ADR-0002 §6 named, none answering this question; PR #22875's reviews 6113872462 and 6114282872; thread: none.

## State and execution

- This card closes `completed` in this act as its decision record, as its own text prescribes; `needs-user-decision` leaves with the close. The `Ruled:` line is added to the body.
- The implementation is filed by this seat on the maintainer's word as a `domain:devx` `tooling` card in `pm:queue` whose first line names the published surface the gate protects (the ADR-0087 disposition every BREAKING changeset ships to consumers), carrying the predicates above, the worked example, the Tier H landing and the `+956 / −10` precedent; its number is recorded in this card's closing comment. The `domain:devx` lane claims and dispatches it; the ADR edit waits on the maintainer's APPROVED review before the seat lands the PR.

Closed `completed` on ruling 6116351873 (batch #319 item 1 → **A**, the maintainer's word verbatim 「22915 同意」): this card is the decision record; the implementation card is #22918 (`tooling` · `domain:devx` · `pm:queue`, first line naming the published surface the gate protects), filed by the director seat on the maintainer's word.
